description:
CONTEXT — PREREQUISITE: flm-40e.5 (Item 3) must be complete. This is the final item and the acceptance-criterion ticket. Items 0–3 deliver the infrastructure; this ticket wires it all together in the todo example and verifies in Chrome. FILES TO MODIFY examples/todo/lib/todo_web/components/todo_list.ex (primary target) FILE ALREADY EXISTS (do NOT recreate): examples/todo/lib/todo_web/components/todo_item.ex Read this file. It already defines a component with props: :todo (required, a map with :id, :text, :done fields) :on_toggle (function, default nil) :on_remove (function, default nil) CURRENT todo_list.ex — WHAT TO REMOVE Read the current file. It likely has: 1. A string-dispatch handle_event pattern: handle_event("toggle:" <> id_str, ...) — DELETE this 2. assigns = Map.merge(assigns, %{todos: todos, filtered: filtered_todos, ...}) boilerplate — DELETE this 3. Items rendered as raw iodata strings in a for loop, not as child components — REPLACE this CURRENT todo_list.ex — WHAT TO KEEP - use_observable/use_hold subscriptions to the Todo.Store - Filter state via use_state (e.g., {filter, set_filter} = use_state(:all)) - The filter tab buttons (they already use closure pattern correctly) - The add-todo input and submit handling TARGET todo_list.ex The component must use ~F templates (VNodeCompiler from Items 1a/1b) with lexical variable scoping. Variables from the component body are referenced as @varname in the template and resolve lexically. Example structure (adapt to actual current code): defcomponent TodoList do def render(props) do {todos, _} = use_observable(Todo.Store) {filter, set_filter} = use_state(:all) filtered = case filter do :all -> todos :active -> Enum.filter(todos, & !&1.done) :done -> Enum.filter(todos, & &1.done) end ~F"""
    <%= for todo <- @filtered do %> Todo.Store.toggle(Todo.Store, todo.id) end} on_remove={fn -> Todo.Store.remove(Todo.Store, todo.id) end} /> <% end %>
text} -> Todo.Store.add(Todo.Store, text) end}>
""" end end CRITICAL: for loops with child components MUST use key= (enforced by VNodeCompiler from Item 1a). Use key={todo.id} on . This enables keyed reconciliation from Items 2/3. REMOVING ASSIGNS BOILERPLATE With lexical scoping (Item 1a), @filtered resolves to the local variable filtered — no need for assigns = Map.merge(assigns, %{filtered: filtered, ...}). Delete all such boilerplate. REMOVING STRING-DISPATCH EVENTS With closure-based event routing (from Items 1a/2 via register_event_handler), the on_toggle and on_remove handlers are closures capturing the specific todo.id. No string dispatch needed. Delete any handle_event("toggle:" <> _, ...) clauses. ALSO CHECK: examples/todo/lib/todo_web/live/todo_live.ex (or equivalent LiveView file) Make sure it uses `use Filament.LiveView` and defines root_component/0 returning the correct module. TODO STORE API (examples/todo/lib/todo/store.ex — read for exact API): Todo.Store.add(Todo.Store, text) -- adds a todo Todo.Store.toggle(Todo.Store, id) -- toggles done/undone Todo.Store.remove(Todo.Store, id) -- removes a todo RUNNING THE DEMO cd examples/todo && mix phx.server Visit http://localhost:4001 in Chrome CHROME ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (verify all in Chrome, do NOT report success without testing): 1. Page loads and displays the todo list 2. Todos from the observable store appear as rendered TodoItem child components (inspect DOM: each todo should have a distinct HTML subtree, not a flat string) 3. Clicking a filter button (All/Active/Done) updates the visible list without page reload 4. Adding a todo via the form input and submit adds it to the list 5. Clicking a toggle button on a todo item marks it done/undone 6. Clicking a remove button on a todo item removes it from the list 7. No JavaScript errors in the Chrome console 8. LiveView websocket connection stays open throughout (no reconnects) TESTING (automated) Run: mix test (from repo root) All existing tests must pass. Specifically: test/filament/examples/todo_example_test.exs covers TodoList behavior; ensure it passes with the new implementation. COMMIT: commit the completed work with message "flm-40e.6: TodoList rewrite with VNodeCompiler and child TodoItem components" EPIC COMPLETE: After this ticket, the epic flm-40e is done. All 5 items (0-4) are implemented and the todo demo is Chrome-verified.
title: Item 4: TodoList rewrite — VNodeCompiler templates, TodoItem child components, Chrome verification
